# PR #2910: Patch: super run failed on a production candidate

Closes #2901

This fixes **`e2e (7/8)`** from [super run 41585437366](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41585437366). I reproduced it locally before the fix. It was spec 38 failing on `/ (phone)`: axe reported `label-content-name-mismatch` (serious, WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name) on `.landing-news-bookmark`.

## Cause

The cause is the News bookmark that #2885 added to the landing page. Its accessible name was `aria-label="News"`, but the only text it shows is the unclaimed count in a red bubble. That bubble is an `aria-hidden` span, and axe treats `aria-hidden` text as visible for this rule, so the visible "2" was missing from the name.

The desktop `/` test passes only because it runs before any sign-in. The phone `/` test runs signed in as p1, because `signedIn` lasts for the rest of the spec file, so the bookmark is drawn there.

## What changed

- **`apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx`**: the name now includes the count whenever the bubble shows. It reads "News, {count} to claim" and "Quests, {count} held", and stays plain "News" or "Quests" with no count. The `title`, the `aria-hidden` bubble and the markup are unchanged. The Quests bookmark has the same markup, so it gets the same fix.
- **`apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`**: two entries, each placed after the key it extends, with `{count}` in both key and value.
- **`landing-news.test.tsx` and `landing-quests.test.tsx`**: five accessible-name assertions in existing `R2875002` and `R2035000` tests:
  - with a count: "News, 2 to claim", "News, 1 to claim" after a claim, and "Quests, 2 held";
  - with no count: plain "News" and "Quests".

No crate, `e2e/`, `spec/` or ruling was touched. The spec doesn't say what a bookmark's accessible name is, and this is presentation, not a rules decision. So there is no new ruling and no patch fragment, since no card plays differently.

## How I checked it

All runs were on this branch's base, `67fa9e5d3`.

**Unit tests** (`pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/landing-news.test.tsx src/routes/landing-quests.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`):
- Before the fix (HEAD's `landing.tsx` swapped in), the two landing files gave 3 failed and 22 passed. The three failures were the count names, with "Expected … News, 2 to claim / Received: News" and the same for "News, 1 to claim" and "Quests, 2 held".
- After the fix: 31 of 31 passed, `i18n.test.ts` included.

**Spec 38 and shard 7**, run the way the super run does:
- Setup:
  - `cargo build --release -p jackioh-server -p jackioh-tools`
  - `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vite build --mode development`
  - the server: `E2E=1 CATALOG_VERSION=$(…/jackioh catalog-version) …/jackioh-server`
  - the client: `E2E=1 vite preview --port 5173 --strictPort`
- Spec 38, command `cd e2e && E2E=1 pnpm exec cypress run --browser chrome --spec cypress/e2e/38-accessibility.cy.ts`, on Chrome 156 headless:
  - **Before the fix** (client built from HEAD's `landing.tsx`): 50 passing, 1 failing. `[axe] / (phone): 1 serious or critical, 1 not excepted`, then `label-content-name-mismatch` on `.landing-news-bookmark`, on both attempts. This is the super run's failure.
  - **After the fix:** 51 passing. `[axe] / (phone): 1 serious or critical, 0 not excepted`; the one left is the existing `.landing-fan-card` exception.
- **The whole shard after the fix**, with `--spec "$(node scripts/shard-specs.mjs 7 8)"`: `All specs passed!`, 75 of 75 (specs 10, 13, 15, 17, 25, 31, 38 and 48).
  - Specs 13, 25, 31 and 48 need `target/release/jackioh` under the repository root, so I linked `target` to `$CARGO_TARGET_DIR` for this run and unlinked it afterwards. Nothing extra is left in the tree.

**Other checks:**
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint` on the three changed `.tsx` files, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo jackioh spec check` all passed.
- The harness's web-test command (`pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main …` with its three excludes): 306 files and 5697 tests passed.

I did not run clippy or the workspace `cargo test`, because no Rust changed.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **I fixed the name rather than spec 38.** I rejected two alternatives:
  - signing the phone pass's public pages out, which would hide a defect every account with unclaimed news meets;
  - adding an axe exception, since exceptions record design decisions and this one has a plain fix.
- **I fixed the Quests bookmark too.** It has the same markup, and would fail spec 38 the first time p1 holds a quest under E2E.
- **Wording:** "to claim" follows R2875002's unread-means-unclaimed and "held" follows R2035000's held count. I used a comma rather than parentheses because axe drops text in parentheses when it compares, so "News (2)" would still fail.

- In `e2e/support/commands.ts`, `signedIn` lasts for the rest of a spec file. So spec 38's phone "public pages" and "practice and hotseat, no account" tests have been running signed in as p1.
